review_scope: User-requested final abundance-goal documentation and machine contracts only; source/result audit reused without repetition.
review_process: One independent integrated read-only review and one bounded verification of the six coordinated repairs; no wider review loop.

repairs_verified.subject: Local and publication branch identity
repairs_verified.observed: GOAL.workspace separates local codex/axisymmetric-reionization-goal-20261014 from existing publish branch codex/rux-science-delivery-20261014 and PR117.

repairs_verified.subject: Five primary shear histories
repairs_verified.observed: CAMPAIGN defines ZERO, positive/negative full amplitude, positive/negative half amplitude; SAME_H is a separate diagnostic. AX08 reuses matching AX07 zero-source/config evidence.

repairs_verified.subject: Angular moment normalization
repairs_verified.observed: Spectral J_l is the solid-angle integral of proper photon-number density. Output energy/H columns map explicitly to U_l=(1/nH) integral E J_l dE; no angular-mean or double-weight convention.

repairs_verified.subject: Matched comparison coordinate
repairs_verified.observed: response_resolution.csv selects ZBAR or PROPER_TIME and stores both candidate/reference times and mean redshifts; simultaneous equality is not assumed for different expansion histories.

repairs_verified.subject: Preparation versus future execution budget
repairs_verified.observed: Zero solver runs are PREPARATION_ONLY. AX06/07/08/11/12 have separate BIND_BEFORE_RUN execution allocations initially bound by AX05 and then by stage; finite budgets can be allocated within existing authorization.

repairs_verified.subject: Scientific review and release completion order
repairs_verified.observed: AX15 decides C01-C16 with C17=PENDING_RELEASE. AX16 verifies actual publication/readback, closes C17, then evaluates GOAL_DONE; release is not a prerequisite for its own review.

contract_checks.abundance_normalization: Element x=n_species/n_element differs from Y=n_species/n_b; full selected-model baryon inventory and omitted reservoirs explicit; H/He-only n_b=n_H+4n_He; electrons excluded from n_b and xe versus ye labelled.
contract_checks.temperature_plot: Actual Tgas in time-ordered parametric trajectories; no temperature sorting or invented monotone thermal clock.
contract_checks.q_and_Sigma: Fixed reference-epoch campaign shear parameter distinct from instantaneous Sigma=s/H.
contract_checks.legacy_data_reuse_scope: Old synthetic endpoints, scoped adapter/transport and report evidence do not complete new abundance science nodes.
contract_checks.manifest_packaging_corrections: Derived CSV identified as 7 pairs from 15 source endpoints; actual report.log.gz and gzip encoding used.

verification_limits.baseline_CI: Prior cargo fmt failure and skipped Rust tests remain inherited disclosed status. This review does not establish green CI.
verification_limits.runtime_model_identity: Requested labels are not observed model evidence; unavailable identity is null.
verification_limits.future_execution: Provider/scenario/driver integration, physical histories, convergence/robustness and final abundance plots remain future tasks. Prepared contracts do not prove their results.

publication_scope: Goal/DAG/packet/controller/normalization/output planning documents and the two existing manifest metadata corrections may be published to the authorized existing branch/PR. Publication success still requires coordinator remote readback; this receipt is not that readback.
